newsitem.title: INDIA: Six Indian policemen killed in mine blast.
newsitem.headline: Six Indian policemen killed in mine blast.

text.p: At least six policemen were killed in a landmine explosion triggered by Maoist guerrillas in India's southern state of Andhra Pradesh on Monday, the United News of India (UNI) said.

The agency quoted police as saying that a police jeep carrying an inspector and six constables was blown up when the People's War Group (PWG) detonated the mine. Two of the group were injured, it added.
The guerrillas are primarily engaged in a struggle against landlords in backward tribal regions.

The police party was part of security arrangements for a public meeting in the state's Warangal district which was scheduled to be addressed by the chief minister, V Chandrababu Naidu, the agency said.
The agency gave no further details.
